parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 168 | 1.71 | 1.71
2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHKH-type
Aquifer depth: 49.4 m – 124 m
Recommendation: Target the thick, moderately resistive sand/sandstone unit between 49.4 m and 124 m (layer 5, 807 Ω·m) as the primary aquifer zone; drill to approximately 125–130 m and set well screens within this interval, terminating before the highly resistive basal layer (>8895 Ω·m) interpreted as bedrock/basement.
